stories.title: Trump revives push to fire Fed's Lisa Cook, seeking to reshape central bank
stories.summary: President Trump is renewing his effort to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, part of a broader push to install allies on the central bank's board. It's the latest round in a fight over Cook's seat that has already played out once before.
stories.whyItMatters: A fight over Fed governors' independence feeds directly into how markets price the future path of interest rates and the central bank's credibility.

Whether the Fed or Cook issues a formal statement

questions: What legal basis is being cited for trying to remove Cook again?

stories.title: 'SaaSpocalypse' debate intensifies as software stocks swing wildly
stories.summary: Software stocks have been whipsawing as investors argue over whether AI is fundamentally disrupting the traditional SaaS subscription model — a scenario some are calling a 'SaaSpocalypse.' The volatility reflects uncertainty about which software companies can adapt.
stories.whyItMatters: Software is a huge chunk of market-cap-weighted tech indexes, so a repricing of the SaaS model would ripple across portfolios well beyond a handful of names.
whatToWatch: Guidance from software companies on AI-driven pricing or seat-count pressure in coming earnings
questions: Which specific companies are seen as most at risk versus most insulated?
